result.description: Email marketing and audience-management platform: lists/audiences, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, e-commerce.
result.auth_detail: API key (own account) or OAuth2 auth-code access token (other users' accounts). Both sent via HTTP Basic (any username, token as password) or Bearer. OAuth tokens don't expire. Base URL is datacenter-specific, found via the OAuth metadata endpoint.
result.access_detail: Any Mailchimp account (including free) can create an API key and register an OAuth app on the Registered Apps page, getting a client_id and client_secret instantly. No app review found for OAuth apps. Free-plan feature limits (e.g. automations) may restrict some endpoints. Not confirmed against the pricing page.
result.api_notes: Marketing API v3.0 REST at https://{dc}.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/. Root endpoint links to all resources. Breadth (lists, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, ecommerce, batch ops, webhooks) is from prior knowledge; I didn't verify it on the docs. Separate Transactional (Mandrill) API exists. No client-side CORS.

evidence.quote: You can use either HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.
